questions.prompt: What does the `volatile` keyword guarantee in the Java Memory Model (JMM), and what does it NOT guarantee?

options.text: Guarantees cross-thread visibility and prevents instruction reordering around the field, but does NOT make compound actions like `count++` atomic

questions.prompt: What are Virtual Threads (Project Loom, Java 21) designed for?

options.text: High-throughput blocking I/O concurrency—lightweight JVM-managed threads where blocking on I/O parks cheaply without tying up an OS carrier thread

questions.prompt: What is 'carrier thread pinning' with Virtual Threads (in Java 21–23), and how is it avoided?

options.text: Performing blocking I/O inside a `synchronized` block or native JNI call pins the virtual thread to its OS carrier thread; use `ReentrantLock` instead of `synchronized` around I/O

questions.prompt: Select all true statements about `ConcurrentHashMap` in Java. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Rejects `null` keys and `null` values (unlike `HashMap`) to avoid ambiguity in concurrent `get()`
`computeIfAbsent(key, fn)` executes atomically per key (avoid recursive updates to the same map inside `fn`!)
`Collections.synchronizedMap` has higher throughput under contention than `ConcurrentHashMap`
Allows concurrent reads without locking and fine-grained bucket-level synchronization on writes

questions.prompt: Match each Java concurrency utility to its ideal role.

columns.label: Lock-free CAS counters (`LongAdder` scales better under high write contention)
Explicit lock with `tryLock(timeout)`, fairness, and Virtual-Thread-friendly parking
Coordinating thread startup/completion barriers or bounding concurrent permits

questions.prompt: In `CompletableFuture`, what is the difference between `thenApply` and `thenCompose`?

options.text: `thenApply` transforms a value synchronously (`T -> U`, like `map`); `thenCompose` chains another async `CompletableFuture` (`T -> CompletableFuture<U>`, like `flatMap`)

questions.prompt: Why can `parallelStream()` hurt performance in a web server?

options.text: It shares the global `ForkJoinPool.commonPool()`, so blocking I/O inside `parallelStream()` starves unrelated tasks across the entire JVM

questions.prompt: What happens when an uncaught exception is thrown inside a `ScheduledExecutorService.scheduleAtFixedRate` task?

options.text: The scheduled task silently stops executing all future runs unless wrapped in `try/catch`!

questions.prompt: Why must `ThreadLocal<T>` values ALWAYS be `.remove()`d when used with pooled platform threads?

options.text: Thread-pool threads are reused across requests, so unremoved `ThreadLocal`s leak data between requests AND leak memory (ClassLoader leaks)
GC clears them on every return

questions.prompt: What does `try { lock.lock(); ... } finally { lock.unlock(); }` guarantee?

options.text: That the `ReentrantLock` is ALWAYS released even if an exception is thrown inside the critical section

questions.prompt: What is a classic cause of `OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space` even with garbage collection?

options.text: Retaining unbounded references (e.g., an un-evicted `static Map` cache, unclosed streams/listeners, or unbounded executor queues)

questions.prompt: How do `G1GC` (default) and `ZGC` (`-XX:+UseZGC -XX:+ZGenerational`) differ?

options.text: ZGC targets sub-millisecond pause times even on multi-gigabyte/terabyte heaps using colored pointers and load barriers, trading a bit of CPU/memory overhead

questions.prompt: Why is setting `-Xms` equal to `-Xmx` (or using `-XX:MaxRAMPercentage` in containers) common in production Java services?

options.text: Avoids repeated heap resize pauses at startup/load, while `MaxRAMPercentage` respects Docker/Kubernetes cgroup memory limits

questions.prompt: Select all tools used to profile and diagnose JVM memory/CPU issues in production. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: JDK Flight Recorder (`jfr`) + JDK Mission Control (`jmc`) with <1% overhead
Async-profiler (CPU/allocation flamegraphs including native/JVM frames without safepoint bias)

questions.prompt: What is 'safepoint bias' in older Java CPU profilers, and what avoids it?

options.text: Sampling threads only at JVM safepoints skews profiles toward safepoint locations; `async-profiler` (`AsyncGetCallTrace`) avoids safepoint bias

questions.prompt: What does `CompletableFuture.allOf(f1, f2).join()` do, and what is a common `join()` vs `get()` difference?

options.text: `join()` wraps exceptions in unchecked `CompletionException`, making it cleaner in lambdas/streams than `get()`'s checked exceptions

questions.prompt: What does `Executors.newFixedThreadPool(n)` use for its task queue by default, and why can it be risky under overload?

options.text: An *unbounded* `LinkedBlockingQueue`, which can accumulate millions of queued tasks and cause `OutOfMemoryError` if producers outpace consumers

questions.prompt: What does `ShutdownHook` (`Runtime.getRuntime().addShutdownHook(...)`) or Spring/framework lifecycle close enable?

options.text: Graceful shutdown on `SIGTERM`: draining in-flight HTTP requests, flushing buffers, and closing DB pools/executors

questions.prompt: Why is `java.io.Serializable` (Java's built-in binary serialization) widely discouraged in modern Java?

options.text: It exposes critical deserialization gadget-chain RCE vulnerabilities, couples tightly to class internals, and bypasses constructors

questions.prompt: Match each Java performance/safety hazard to its mitigation.
What does `Double-Checked Locking` for a lazy singleton require in Java?

options.text: The singleton field MUST be declared `volatile` so another thread cannot observe a partially constructed object due to instruction reordering

questions.prompt: Why is the Initialization-on-Demand Holder idiom thread-safe without `synchronized`?

options.text: The JVM guarantees class initialization (`<clinit>`) is synchronized and executed at most once when `Holder` is first referenced

questions.prompt: What does `JIT` (Just-In-Time) compilation's 'warmup' phase mean for Java microbenchmarks?

options.text: Early iterations run interpreted/C1-compiled before C2 optimizes hot paths (inlining, escape analysis), so benchmarks MUST use JMH warmup iterations

questions.prompt: What is Escape Analysis in the HotSpot C2 JIT compiler?

options.text: Proving an allocated object never escapes a method/thread, allowing scalar replacement (allocating fields in registers/stack) and lock elision

questions.prompt: Select all true statements about Java `record`s and `BigDecimal` / `Optional` best practices. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Use `BigDecimal.compareTo(other) == 0` for numerical equality (since `equals()` also checks scale: `1.0` != `1.00`!)
Use `try-with-resources` for all `AutoCloseable` I/O, JDBC `Connection`/`PreparedStatement`/`ResultSet`, and HTTP bodies
Validate `record` invariants inside a compact constructor

questions.prompt: What does `PreparedStatement` with `?` bind parameters prevent in JDBC?

options.text: SQL injection—and enables database query-plan caching

questions.prompt: What does `StructuredTaskScope` (Java 21+ preview/incubator structured concurrency) solve over raw `ExecutorService`?

options.text: Ties subtasks' lifetimes to a lexical `try-with-resources` block—cancelling sibling subtasks automatically on failure (`ShutdownOnFailure`) and preventing leaked orphan threads

questions.prompt: What does `Foreign Function & Memory API` (`MemorySegment`, `Arena`, finalized in Java 22) replace?

options.text: Fragile JNI boilerplate and unsafe `sun.misc.Unsafe` for deterministic off-heap memory and native C library calls

questions.prompt: What does `WeakHashMap<K, V>` do when a key object has no other strong references?

options.text: Allows the GC to reclaim the key and automatically removes the entry from the map (useful for metadata caches keyed by `Class`/`Object`)

questions.prompt: What is a ClassLoader memory leak (`OutOfMemoryError: Metaspace`) in app servers/plugin systems?

options.text: A static/global reference (like a `ThreadLocal`, JDBC driver, or shutdown hook) holding a class/instance from an unloaded plugin `ClassLoader`, preventing Metaspace reclamation

questions.prompt: Why should `CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(fn)` take an explicit `Executor` in production services?

options.text: Without an explicit `Executor`, it defaults to `ForkJoinPool.commonPool()`, which is sized for CPU cores and easily starved by blocking I/O
It creates a new thread per call always

questions.prompt: What does `Objects.checkIndex(index, length)` (Java 9+) provide?

options.text: A JVM-intrinsic bounds check throwing `IndexOutOfBoundsException` that JIT optimizes cleanly

questions.prompt: Match each Java diagnostic or runtime concept to its meaning.

JIT optimization eliminating non-escaping object allocations
Native-memory region storing loaded class metadata

questions.prompt: What does `ClassValue<T>` (`java.lang.ClassValue`) solve for frameworks/libraries?

options.text: Thread-safe, ClassLoader-leak-free lazy caching of computed metadata per `Class<?>`

questions.prompt: What happens if two threads call `map.computeIfAbsent(k, ...)` on a `HashMap` (non-concurrent) simultaneously?

options.text: Undefined/corrupted internal structure, lost updates, or `ConcurrentModificationException`

questions.prompt: What does `var` + `final` or immutable DTOs (`record`) improve for multi-threaded Java?

options.text: Immutable objects with `final` fields have safe-publication guarantees in the JMM and can be shared freely across threads without locks

questions.prompt: Select all true statements about `Java` Modules (`module-info.java`, JPMS). (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Enables `jlink` to build minimal custom runtime images containing only needed JDK modules
Every Maven project fails to compile without `module-info.java`
Explicitly declares `requires` dependencies and `exports` public packages
Strong encapsulation hides non-exported internal packages even from reflection unless `opens` is declared

questions.prompt: What does `jwebserver` (JDK 18+) or `mvn test` / `gradle test --continuous` support?

options.text: Fast local static serving (`jwebserver`) and continuous test feedback loops during development

questions.prompt: Why is `Random` (`java.util.Random`) discouraged in hot multi-threaded code compared to `ThreadLocalRandom.current()`?

options.text: `java.util.Random` uses a shared `AtomicLong` seed causing CAS contention across threads; `ThreadLocalRandom` is contention-free (and use `SecureRandom` for crypto!)

questions.prompt: What does `CompletableFuture.exceptionally(ex -> fallback)` do?

options.text: Recovers from a failed upstream stage by returning a fallback value

questions.prompt: Select all best practices for reliable Java production services. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Log structured context (e.g. MDC/SLF4J) without logging secrets or PII
Ignore `InterruptedException` (`catch (InterruptedException e) {}`) without restoring interrupt flag
Set explicit connect/read timeouts on `HttpClient` and JDBC pools (HikariCP)

questions.prompt: When catching `InterruptedException` in a method that cannot declare `throws InterruptedException`, what MUST you do?

options.text: Call `Thread.currentThread().interrupt();` to preserve the cancellation/interrupt signal for callers
